Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today — great to learn more about FinPath's latency-sensitive workflows and how you're thinking about inference economics across models. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: primary use case is document summarization + prompt-based routing for higher-value workflows; target latency is ~200ms median, 95th < 500ms.
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence for vendor security, SSO (SAML/OAuth) support, and procurement/PO process for annual contract.
- Next step: technical demo + security deep-dive where we'll have Dylan (solutions engineer) walk through architecture and Dev (security contact) / Procurement can join to align on evidence and timelines.

Would the following slots work for a 60-min session?
- Wed 11/25, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 11/26, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Mon 11/30, 13:00–14:00 PT

If you can confirm the best time and any additional folks to include (security, procurement, platform), I’ll send a calendar invite and attach a short security checklist and procurement intake doc for your team to review beforehand.

Attachments: Prelim-Security-Checklist.pdf (stub), Procurement-MA-Checklist.docx (stub)
